title: PermissionsCommand
responsibility: Expose source-declared user profiles and endpoint/data grants through revision-aware CLI queries.

inputs.name: PermissionsCommand.register.program
inputs.description: Commander command that receives the `permissions` namespace with its `list` and `show <profile>` actions. It is needed when registering those profile queries; registration does not produce a query result.

inputs.name: PermissionsCommand.registerApi.api
inputs.description: Commander command under which `permissions [endpoint]` is registered. The optional endpoint argument filters returned grants by exact resource id, and this command exposes only the `--root` option.

outputs.name: PermissionsCommand.register
outputs.description: Returns no value and registers `permissions list` and `permissions show <profile>` with `--root`, `--commit`, `--branch`, and `--json` options. When invoked, the actions print JSON; `show` throws an Error if the profile id is absent.

outputs.name: PermissionsCommand.registerApi
outputs.description: Returns no value and registers `permissions [endpoint]` with a `--root` option. When invoked, it prints JSON containing the endpoint filter, profiles with matching API grants, and catalog gaps.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: The `show <profile>` action throws this Error with message `Unknown permission profile: <id>` when no catalog profile has the requested id.
